method: Fresh direct web opens of original cited pages, followed by fresh requests retrieval and raw SHA256. Coordinates manually inspected in web output and parsed again from freshly saved source text. No earlier audit answers were consulted. Only hemisphere/sign normalization and trailing-zero equivalence applied; no frame transformation.
limitations: Luna supplemental LROC mission-specific links now redirect to a generic page; HTTP 200 must not be reported as successfully retrieved mission evidence.
No disagreement among the inspected NASA Apollo table, corresponding artifact rows, Luna artifact rows, and repeated Frontiers captions was found. This is not an exhaustive literature comparison.
Initial extraction attempt failed before any HTTP request because bs4 is unavailable; retried successfully using standard-library HTML tag stripping. Raw HTML was retained for inspection.

rows.catalogue_note: Planned science target, not an observed landing or a confirmed touchdown point. KASI associates LUSEM with IM-3/CP-11 at Reiner Gamma; https://pda.kasi.re.kr/lusem.php?lang=en .
rows.short_excerpt: The targeted LVx landing site (7.585°N, 58.725°W) is denoted by a yellow star
rows.locator: Figure 3 caption; same numeric coordinates appear in Figures 9 and 10 captions.
rows.precision_caveat: Three decimal places; planned target published 11 August 2022, not a measured touchdown. The paper alone does not establish the final IM-3 mission point or current mission status.
rows.frame_caveat: Figure captions specify N/W hemispheres but do not explicitly declare ME/PA DE421. LROC WAC basemap context does not by itself prove frame identity or a frame conversion.

additional_check.result: Same 7.585°N, 58.725°W; Figure 3 explicitly calls the point targeted.
